decisive_items: the mass appeared pinkish-yellow rather than the typical salmon pink of lymphoid lesions
Orbital computed tomography demonstrated a purely conjunctival, homogeneous mass isodense to muscle without infiltration of adjacent structures.
response.rationale: The description of a pinkish-yellow conjunctival mass and the imaging findings support conjunctival amyloidosis as the most likely diagnosis, with conjunctival fibroma being a plausible alternative due to the soft-tissue nature of the lesion.

rejected.why: The appearance of the mass does not match the typical salmon pink of lymphoid lesions, contradicting lymphoma.
The atypical color of the mass and lack of other supporting evidence make lymphoproliferative disorder less likely.
The appearance of the mass is not typical for lymphoid hyperplasia, and other findings do not strongly support this diagnosis.
While the description of a soft-tissue lesion could support granuloma, the specific details and imaging findings are more consistent with amyloidosis.
